ShaderNodePreset.Description: Resolution-independent rounded-rect phone matte with an adjustable lozenge-shaped camera cutout, for matting real phone camera plates back into a mockup.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: MM_PhoneMatte

Uniform.Name: PosX
Uniform.Tooltip: Horizontal position of the phone matte, in pixels

Uniform.Name: PosY
Uniform.Tooltip: Vertical position of the phone matte, in pixels

Uniform.Name: Width
Uniform.Tooltip: Phone matte width, as a proportion of frame height

Uniform.Name: Height
Uniform.Tooltip: Phone matte height, as a proportion of frame height

Uniform.Name: CornerRadius
Uniform.Tooltip: Roundness of the phone body's corners

Uniform.Name: EdgeSoftness
Uniform.Tooltip: Feather on the matte edges - 0 for a hard-edged garbage matte, higher to soften for compositing
Toggle a cutout hole where the camera lens sits, so real camera-plate footage can be matted back in behind it
Uniform.Name: HoleOn
HolePosX
Uniform.Tooltip: Horizontal offset of the camera hole from the phone matte's centre, as a proportion of frame height

Uniform.Name: HolePosY
Uniform.Tooltip: Vertical offset of the camera hole from the phone matte's centre, as a proportion of frame height

Uniform.Name: HoleHeight
Uniform.Tooltip: Height of the camera cutout - set taller/narrower than Width for a lozenge covering a camera+sensor cluster

Uniform.Name: HoleRoundness
Uniform.Tooltip: 0 = sharp rounded-rect cutout, 1 = full lozenge/pill shape with fully rounded ends. Not used when Hole Style is set to Waterdrop.

Uniform.Name: HoleStyle
Uniform.Tooltip: 0 = lozenge/pill cutout (uses Hole Roundness), 1 = waterdrop/teardrop notch - a circle with a small subtle point on top, 2 = Phone Lens notch - traced from a real reference photo: a narrow rounded-bottom capsule flaring out to the full cutout width at the top via concave fillets. For style 2, Hole Width sets the flat top edge width and Hole Height sets how deep it extends down
